title: Fighting Fader
expanded_details:
Fighting the final boss lets goooo!

Summoning:
- Need to find the Alter to summon him.
- We need to get three Bells for the summoning process.

Attack damage types to focus on:
  - Neutral to: Blunt, Slash, Frost, Lightning, and Poison
  - Resistant to: Pierce
  - Immune to: Fire, Spirit, Chop, Pickaxe

Damage type for each attack style:
Ranged: Pick arrows that do statuses like lightning/frost/poison
Magic: Pick the frost or lightning staff for direct damage. Any soul staff should work to do other damage but check the entity damage type
Melee: Focus on Maces/Hammers, Swords, or Lightning/Frost status weapons

Fader's damage abilities:
A lot of up close attacks that do a lot of pierce/chop/pickaxe damage
Some fire attacks that do fire/spirit

What to bring:
- Good armor will be important
- Fire resistance mead will be critical
- <There will be more, this is just my list after a first glance>
